manifest.question: In the R4 position-phase element model, do label-free detected resonators form reproducibly, survive small perturbations, and depend causally on both coupling directions (geometry->mode and mode->geometry), with each direction's effect vanishing under its matched ablation?

hypotheses.H-M: geometry and activity influence one another
hypotheses.H-C_precursor: a stable structure exposes a reusable effective unit

model.neighbor_update: recomputed at the start of every RK4 step and held for its four stages

statistics.unit: world (seed); its effect is the mean over its accepted resonators

verdict_rules.H-M: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE if identical-arm formation >= 0.8 and both causality endpoints PASS; NOT_SUPPORTED if either causality endpoint FAILs (intact CI includes 0 or wrong sign); INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.H-C_precursor: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE if H-M is supported and >= 90% of accepted identical-arm units meet every effective-state bound; NOT_SUPPORTED if fewer do; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.causality: PASS if the intact paired-effect bootstrap CI lies above 0 and the matched-ablation CI includes 0 or its |mean| <= 0.2 x intact mean; FAIL if the intact CI includes 0 or lies below it; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.primary_arm: identical; the heterogeneous arm is evaluated with the same rules and reported separately

seeds.rule: final entropy drawn with secrets.randbits(63) at registration; final worlds are never simulated before the recorded panel; smoke uses development worlds

endpoints.formation_identical: fraction of final worlds with >= 1 accepted resonator, Wilson 95% CI; expectation >= 0.8
endpoints.g_to_m_identical: G->M paired effect (intact) and matched w=1 ablation, bootstrap CIs; causality rule
endpoints.m_to_g_identical: M->G paired effect (intact) and matched J=0 ablation, bootstrap CIs; causality rule
endpoints.both_off_identical: descriptive: G->M and M->G paired effects with J=0 and w=1 (neighbor selection remains geometry-dependent)
endpoints.not_a_clump_identical: detector accepts no resonator under J=K=0 (detector-validity gate)
endpoints.effective_state_identical: >= 90% of accepted units meet every effective-state bound (worst unit reported)
endpoints.ablation_formation: descriptive: formation counts and rejection reasons under each ablation from the same initial worlds
endpoints.numerical_checks: RK4 order with held neighbor sets, switching-limited full-model dt error, and permutation/translation/rotation/global-phase equivariance (implementation gate)

gates: passing focused contracts for the exact dependency fingerprint
complete panel for every final world in both arms
source hashes stable during the run
registered_changes_from_proposal: Candidate groups are components of a graph joining pairs that are both close and phase-locked over the window (proposal: proximity only). Reason: in the heterogeneous arm, unlocked drifting elements merge with locked groups spatially, so proximity-only components never test the locked groups themselves.
Recovery kicks have fixed size (random direction, exact RMS) so rejection of a non-restoring clump is deterministic.
The J=K=0 clump is rejected by criterion 5 (phase-pattern recovery), not criteria 3-4: with identical omega and K=0, frozen phases trivially satisfy 3-4.

G->M adds an identical zero-mean phase probe kick (RMS 0.3) to both runs of the pair: exact synchrony is a fixed point for any geometry, so scaling alone cannot move a synchronized pattern; the statistic is the time-mean pattern deviation over 5 time units.

Ablations are matched on state: each control/treated pair starts from the same intact formed state and runs under the ablated dynamics. Formation from scratch under each ablation is reported descriptively.
Effective-state bounds and validity are judged on the identical arm (primary); thresholds settled on development worlds only.
Both-off (J=0, w=1) is descriptive, not a vanish test: development worlds showed geometry still reaches the phases through neighbor selection.
dt check split: RK4 order with held neighbor sets, plus a tolerance on the switching-limited full-model error (neighbor sets change at step boundaries, so the full model converges at first order).
Effective-state validity requires >= 90% of accepted units within bounds (worst reported); a single worst-unit maximum was fragile on development worlds where two groups drift apart.

limitations: A mechanism probe of known swarmalator dynamics: no novelty, hierarchy (C5+), task-usefulness, efficiency or energy claim.
One model family, one element count (N = 24), one neighbor rule and one parameter set; no sweep.
The identical-omega arm is a synchronizing fixture: its mode has collective frequency 0, and G->M is measured through the restoring rate of a probe kick, not through a spontaneous mode change.
Ablations are matched on state (pairs start from the intact formed state); with J = 0 and w = 1, geometry still reaches the phases through neighbor selection (reported as both_off).
Detector thresholds were settled on development worlds; changes from the proposal are listed in the manifest.
next_action: One independent review by the other model family (Codex), on the committed evidence; no C5 work before acceptance.
